info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Streaming Subscriptions Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Status API provides real-time insights into the status of active streaming subscriptions. This endpoint allows clients to efficiently retrieve the current state of their subscriptions, helping them monitor performance and manage resources effectively. Typical consumers of this API include developers and system administrators looking to integrate subscription status data into their applications or dashboards. By leveraging this API, users can ensure optimal configuration and responsiveness of their streaming services.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to retrieve the current status of their subscriptions, providing important information regarding activity, billing, and any potential issues.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of subscriptions. This body must conform to the defined schema which specifies the structure of the required data.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current subscription status.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsStatusRequest.description: A string representing the subscription status for the requested operations.
